caption: The drawing consists of three objects, all depicted in light brown and golden hues, resembling intricate knot-shaped brooches or fibulae with pin components. The first object, positioned slightly above the center, has a coiled, spiral design with three loops encircling a vertical bar, and a long pin extending downward from the base. The second object, located below and to the left, displays a similar multi-looped coil with a straight vertical bar running through its center and a needle-like pin protruding downward. The third object, situated to the right, shows a similar structure but is oriented more to the side, with the pin angled outward and partially separated, revealing a detailed view of both the coil and its fastening mechanism. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the form and details of the three gold-toned objects, which are arranged in a triangular composition with ample negative space around them.
title: Brooch
